title: Arrival shakeout + strength
terrain: travel to Schilpario, gentle valley trail, ascent-biased, cap descent at 200m

steps.target: Z2, 84-89% LTHR, gentle uphill, walk anything steep down

coachNotes: Arrival day, and the day the week's descent budget is easiest to leak. A loosener on mountain trails means downhill you did not plan for, so pick an out-and-back that climbs and walk every metre of the return. Hard cap 200m of descent. Then the glute med work that moved off Tuesday: single-leg squats, side plank with leg lift, monster walks, 3 sets each, and do it properly because it is the last strength session before three mountain days. Garmin target 45-55. ITB check tonight before bed: single-leg squat, direct pressure on the lateral epicondyle at 30 degrees flexion, descending stairs. Any of the three positive and Friday's hike gets cut before the traverse, not during it.
